description: Apply to any inline icon element (i, span, svg wrapper) to get square, color-inheriting icon sizing. Size is controlled by data-size attribute or the --icon-size custom property. All icons are square (equal width and height). Color is always currentColor — set it on the parent. Font Awesome icons, SVGs, and any inline icon font all work.

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: Controls icon size via --sherpa-size-* tokens. md = 20px (default). See size token mapping below.

cssProperties.name: --icon-size
cssProperties.description: Override icon size directly. Takes precedence over data-size. Set via inline style or a parent rule.

notes: display:inline-flex with align-items:center; justify-content:center — icons are always vertically and horizontally centred.
flex-shrink:0 — icon never collapses inside a flex row.
color:inherit — set color on the parent element or via data-status on an ancestor.
SVG children receive width:1em; height:1em; fill:currentColor automatically.
Components (sherpa-button, sherpa-nav-item, etc.) apply this class internally — only use it directly for standalone icons in light DOM.
